summary: Ignored local audit and test report artifacts so npm audit JSON, coverage, Playwright reports, and Vercel local metadata are not committed accidentally.
findings: The repository now recommends generating npm-audit JSON during triage, but .gitignore did not ignore generated npm audit report files.
Common local test/report directories were not ignored either, which can create noisy or sensitive commits.
actions_taken: Added coverage, playwright-report, test-results, and npm-audit*.json to .gitignore.
Kept the change documentation-only/config-only; no runtime behavior changed.
next_cycle_focus: Verify Vercel status for the gitignore-only commit.
Generate npm audit JSON in a connected environment and remediate the reported packages directly.
Commit package-lock.json after dependency versions are audited and stable.
